subject: Botany
stem: Consider a population of 10 million cells. Given the per-capita birth rate of 0.002 (per unit time) and the per-capita death rate of 0.002 (per unit time), the expected number of cells after 10 generations is _________.
solution: NCERT-XII-193. \(r = b - d\); \(r = 0.002 - 0.002 = 0\). \(N_t = N_0 e^{rt}\); here \(t = 10\) generations; \(N_t = N_0 e^{0 \times 10} = N_0 e^0\). Here \(N_0 = 10\) million, so \(N_t = 10\) million.
